identificationModule.briefTitle: Switching Regimen in Treating Cirrhotic HCV GT1b Subjects
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Switching From Pegylated Interferon/Ribavirin (PR) to Direct-acting Antiviral Agents (DAAs) for Chinese With CHC Genotype 1b Infection (SWITCH-1)

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a prospective, randomized study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of switching treatment from Peg-interferon and Ribavirin to direct-acting antiviral agents in Chinese with CHC genotype 1b infection, who are interferon/ribavirin-intolerant.

armGroups.label: PR4 + LDV/SOF + ASV 4 wk
armGroups.description: Participants treated with 4 weeks pegylated interferon and ribavirin and plasma HCV RNA \<25 IU/ml by week 2 will receive LDV/SOF + ASV for 4 weeks.

interventions.name: PR4 + LDV/SOF + ASV 4 wk
interventions.description: Pegylated interferon alfa-2a (PEG) 180 μg administered once weekly by subcutaneous injection; Ribavirin (RBV) administered as a tablet orally according to body weight (\< 75kg = 1000 mg and ≥ 75 kg = 1200 mg); Ledipasvir/sofosbuvir (LDV/SOF) 90 mg/400 mg fixed dose combination (FDC) tablet administered orally once daily; Asunaprevir (ASV) 200mg administered orally twice daily.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants with sustained virologic response 12 weeks (SVR12) after discontinuation of therapy
primaryOutcomes.description: SVR12 is defined as HCV RNA \< lower limit of quantification (LLOQ) 12 weeks after last dose of study drug.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants with adverse events leading to permanent discontinuation of study drug(s)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of participants with unquantifiable HCV viral load at specified time points during and after treatment

secondaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate the proportion of patients adherent to therapy (both on-treatment adherence and treatment discontinuation)

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in health related quality of life evaluated with questionnaires
secondaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate the change in health-related quality of life during and after treatment with questionnaires

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in mental health evaluated with questionnaires
secondaryOutcomes.description: To evaluate the change in mental health during and after treatment with questionnaires

Liver disease progression is a composite endpoint measured by laboratory parameters (alanine aminotransferase (ALT), aspartate aminotransferase (AST), bilirubin, albumin, platelets, prothrombin time (PT) and α-fetoprotein) and observed or reported clinical signs and symptoms.
